title: 腾空跳跃封面
subject: border-collie

revision.reviewFinding: 旧版只替换了宠物主体，主体仍偏照片质感，没有完整转译为效果参考图的手绘媒介。

prompt: Use case: style-transfer with pet identity preservation. Create a vertical 9:16 expressive hand-painted pet action cover at exactly 720x1280 pixels from exactly two input images. Image 1 is the primary effect, composition and physical-medium reference. Preserve its joyful head-on leap, two oversized foreground paws, compact airborne body, open delighted expression, turquoise field, magenta-purple lower strokes, orange-yellow accents and energetic framing. Remove only its platform watermark and account ID. Render the entire final image as unmistakable thick impasto painting. The Border Collie's face, ears, muzzle, eyes, nose, mouth, teeth, tongue, every black-and-white coat area, legs and paw pads must all be constructed from visible opaque brush strokes and palette-knife marks. Represent fur as simplified directional clumps of pigment, never as fine photographic strands. Paint the eyes, nose and paw pads as expressive shaped colour masses with hand-painted highlights, never as glossy photo surfaces. Image 2 is an identity-only reference. Use it solely to identify breed anatomy, coat colour blocks, facial markings, eye colour and recognisable proportions. Do not copy Image 2's photographic rendering, individual photo-real hair strands, camera lighting, lens blur, skin or fur microtexture, glossy photographic highlights or cut-out edges. Reconstruct the pet from the ground up inside Image 1's hand-painted medium. The animal and background must visibly be one continuous artwork made by the same artist, with the same brush family, pigment thickness, edge language, colour granulation and level of abstraction. The pet must remain youthful, healthy, rounded and immediately lovable, with correct anatomy and no extra or fused limbs. Preserve from Image 2 the narrow white facial blaze, white muzzle and chest, black coat blocks, warm brown eyes, black nose and semi-upright ears of the same Border Collie. Translate every identity marking into clearly visible painted strokes. Keep all four limbs anatomically readable: two front paws toward the viewer and two distinct rear legs behind. The dog must look joyous, fluffy and compact rather than long or skinny. Reject any mixed-media result: no photorealistic animal pasted over a painted background, no photographic fur, no airbrushed 3D render, no lens detail, no cut-out halo, no smooth digital-photo face, no text, logo, watermark or signature.

findings: 边牧的眼鼻、口舌、毛发、四肢与爪垫均由厚涂笔触和刮刀颜料构成，主体与背景媒介一致，不再呈现照片抠图感。
